protocol.task: Pick a tabletop cube and release it fully inside a declared target region.
protocol.success: Cube released fully inside the target before the declared timeout, without human contact, emergency stop, or safety violation.
protocol.reset: Publish cube dimensions, target dimensions, start pose and reset procedure before counted trials. Restore that declared start state for each trial.
protocol.trials: Declare timeout and at least ten planned trials before running. Record every counted attempt, success, intervention, exclusion, deviation and first decisive failure. Blocked or unsafe attempts may complete zero trials.
protocol.configuration: Before trials, commit robot, gripper, cameras, calibration method, compute, framework and dependency versions, observation/action shapes and control rate beside robot-skill.yaml. Link immutable revisions. Changes require a separately labeled cohort, never pooled counts.
protocol.safety: Each team owns its risk assessment, safe operating envelope and emergency stop. No people in the envelope. Stop unexpected or uncertain motion; never bypass limits or safety controls.
protocol.comparison: Compatibility study, not a leaderboard or physical safety certification. Preserve failed and withdrawn attempts; separate simulation from physical results. Review grants no registry verification status.
